lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.unitTitle: Body Signals and Building a Fueling Meal
lessonRef.title: Launch and diagnostic: hunger thirst tiredness boredom and stress signals

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice hunger thirst tiredness boredom and stress signals. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: Before any explicit instruction on noticing technique, the learner pauses twice during an ordinary day and tries, on their own, to name which of the five signals they're feeling and what physical clue told them so.
safetyNotes: Notebook entries are private; a guardian may see the completion status but not the raw entries themselves.
No weight, size, calorie, or body-shape language is used anywhere in this task.
materials: learner-local: private notebook or digital note

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u04-l01-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u04-l01-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u04-l01-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u04-l01-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Did you mix up two signals at any point today (like thirst feeling like hunger)? Describe what happened without judging yourself for it.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l01-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l01-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g5-u04-l01-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Signal-word accuracy: Both entries use one of the five neutral words correctly. | Honest, non-judgmental noticing: Entry is neutral and, if a mix-up happened, describes it factually. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l01-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: On a second day, notice the same two time-of-day moments and compare whether the signal or the clue changed from day one to day two.

resources.title: hunger thirst tiredness boredom and stress signals worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: Before any explicit instruction on noticing technique, the learner pauses twice during an ordinary day and tries, on their own, to name which of the five signals they're feeling and what physical clue told them so.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact hunger thirst tiredness boredom and stress signals decision or action.

Model move 2: Before today's noticing, which of the five signal words (hunger, thirst, tiredness, boredom, stress) do you think you already notice easily, and which do you think you mix up with another one?
Model move 3: At two separate points today, pause and name the signal you're feeling and the physical clue that told you.
Model check: Signal-word accuracy: Both entries use one of the five neutral words correctly. | Honest, non-judgmental noticing: Entry is neutral and, if a mix-up happened, describes it factually.

resources.title: hunger thirst tiredness boredom and stress signals coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: Before any explicit instruction on noticing technique, the learner pauses twice during an ordinary day and tries, on their own, to name which of the five signals they're feeling and what physical clue told them so.

Coach direction: Before today's noticing, which of the five signal words (hunger, thirst, tiredness, boredom, stress) do you think you already notice easily, and which do you think you mix up with another one?
Learner prompt: Name the easy one and the confusable one.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: hunger thirst tiredness boredom and stress signals complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: At two separate points today, pause and name the signal you're feeling and the physical clue that told you.
Response 1 (t2-p1): Record your two moments: the signal word and the clue for each, using neutral language only.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: hunger thirst tiredness boredom and stress signals minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Did you mix up two signals at any point today (like thirst feeling like hunger)? Describe what happened without judging yourself for it.
Success checks: Signal-word accuracy: Both entries use one of the five neutral words correctly. | Honest, non-judgmental noticing: Entry is neutral and, if a mix-up happened, describes it factually.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: hunger thirst tiredness boredom and stress signals supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l01-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g5-u04-l01-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional hunger thirst tiredness boredom and stress signals condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Signal-word accuracy: Both entries use one of the five neutral words correctly. | Honest, non-judgmental noticing: Entry is neutral and, if a mix-up happened, describes it factually..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l01-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.
